column1: # The kill command decides whether a mutant is KILLED. The template MUST
# contain the literal {mutant}; the engine substitutes the mutant's path.
# The command MUST exit 0 on the unmutated source and non-zero on a broken one
# — the engine verifies BOTH before it will report a score.
# A changed shell file with NO row here is reported UNSCORED and named. It is
# NOT scored as 0% (which would be a fabricated failure) and NOT as 100%
# (which would be a fabricated pass). An unscored file is an honest gap.
# EMPTY of rows at creation: no source file has an operator-approved kill
# command yet, because enforcement itself is still an open operator decision
